newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Forbo confirms sees unchanged 1996 net.
newsitem.headline: Forbo confirms sees unchanged 1996 net.

text.p: Forbo Holding AG, a leading European floor and wall-coverings maker, confirmed on Friday that it expected 1996 net profit to stay at the same level as 1995's 55.6 million Swiss francs.
Forbo said the dividend would be unchanged for the third year in a row at 19 francs.
It repeated an October statement that it was setting aside 25-30 million Swiss francs to dispose of unprofitable activities.
"Preliminary results from operating subsidiaries indicate a cashflow level above that of last year," Forbo added. Cashflow in 1995 was 160 million francs.
